entries.archive_status: not archived: the page changed before it could be archived
quotes: The investor must be a partner in an existing or newly established establishment or company, with a financial share of at least AED 2,000,000.
The invested capital must be fully owned by the investor and must not be derived from a loan.
The investor must have a financial deposit of at least AED 2,000,000 with an investment fund or one of the national banks operating in the UAE.
The investor must own an establishment or company that is committed to paying the taxes due to the Federal Government, amounting to at least AED 250,000 annually.
The investor must own one or more properties in the UAE with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000, with full ownership of the property registered in the investor's name.
The property may be financed through a loan, provided that the financing is obtained from an approved local bank.
The investor must have purchased one or more off-plan property units with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000, provided that the purchase is made from an approved local real estate company
The investor and their family members must have comprehensive and valid health insurance coverage throughout the validity period of the residency.
Eligible applicants for Golden Residency who are outside the UAE are granted a six-month, multiple-entry entry visa
10 years for investors in the UAE's real estate sector.
